result.title: TraceSampler: Making Sampling Errors Predictable and Correctable for Accelerated Generative Sampling
result.summary: Accurate sampling from continuous-time generative models can require many model evaluations. Low-step sampling reduces cost, but coarse updates introduce endpoint errors that can accumulate and degrade generation quality. We introduce TraceSampler, a post-training method that corrects these errors without modifying the pretrained model. Rather than optimising low-step updates directly, TraceSampler models endpoint error as a sample-specific prediction problem. A higher-step reference integration over the same interval provides the supervised target, while a compact representation makes high-dimensional error predictable from the sampling trace. This representation combines shared residual structure, trace-derived directions, and a low-rank remainder, so shallow per-step MLP heads predict sample-dependent coefficients. These coefficients drive a two-stage learned residual correction: the first stage predicts the full endpoint residual, while an intermediate backbone evaluation provides new trace information to predict the remaining residual; this evaluation is reused by the following step. TraceSampler is evaluated with Rectified Flow on CIFAR-10, SiT-XL/2 on ImageNet-256, and SD3.5 Medium for text-to-image generation. At 10 steps, it reduces trajectory MSE relative to matched-step Euler by 90.5% on CIFAR-10 and 85.6% on ImageNet-256, while achieving FID scores of 2.692 and 2.189, close to 120-step Heun references of 2.601 and 2.056 with 24$\times$ fewer backbone evaluations. On SD3.5 Medium, TraceSampler improves image quality and prompt following; at 10 steps, ImageReward rises from 0.752 to 0.906 while trajectory MSE falls by 70.7%. These gains preserve Euler's backbone-evaluation budget, add less than 0.4% inference FLOPs, and incur negligible wall-clock overhead, showing that coarse-step sampling error can be made predictable from the sampling trace and efficiently corrected.

AI.brief_summary: TraceSampler 是一种后训练方法，用于加速扩散/Rectified Flow 等连续时间生成模型的低步采样：把端点误差建模为样本相关的预测问题，用高阶参考积分作监督，将高维误差分解为共享残差结构、轨迹导出方向与低秩余项，并由浅层 MLP 头预测系数，经两阶段残差修正（中间评估结果被下一步复用）降低误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 原文「从采样轨迹预测高维误差、分解为共享/轨迹方向/低秩余项并做两阶段修正」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理循环中的状态漂移预测、残差修正与中间评估复用；但该文面向图像生成采样而非视觉推理，迁移性属推测。
